fork_fee_mechanism_active.meaning: GTELaunchpadV2Pair._update reduces the reserve update amount directly instead of charging swap fees from the input amount.

identical_swap_performed.meaning: An identical swap is performed on both the forked pair and the reference Uniswap-like pair.

fork_lp_portfolio_value.meaning: LP portfolio value after the identical swap on the forked pair.

reference_lp_portfolio_value.meaning: LP portfolio value after the identical swap on the reference Uniswap-like pair.

assumptions: The reference pair implements standard Uniswap V2 fee behavior, allowing a fair comparison of LP portfolio value.
The identical swap moves the price away from equilibrium in the same manner on both pairs.

unresolved.description: The report does not provide numeric reserve, swap, or LP portfolio decline values, so the LP portfolio value comparison cannot be instantiated with concrete quantities.
The report does not state whether any specific swap or arbitrage transaction was actually observed on-chain; the scenario is described through a test and potential backrun.

limitations: The value relation is formalized as fork LP portfolio value >= reference LP portfolio value under an identical swap; the report does not provide numeric portfolio values, so the relation is symbolic.
Other impacts i_value_leak, i_fee_erosion, and i_arb_extract are deferred to future claims.
No actor identity or permission details for who may call _update or trigger swaps are provided.
The report labels value capture risk free but provides no transaction-level proof of realized arbitrage.
